name: VR Smart Grid Lite
summary: VR Smart Grid Lite is a grid trading Expert Advisor that places pending orders at fixed price intervals around the current market price, aiming to profit from price oscillations within a range. The EA systematically opens buy and sell limit/stop orders at predetermined grid levels, managing multiple positions simultaneously. It is a lite version of the full VR Smart Grid product with reduced configuration options.
summary_zh: VR Smart Grid Lite是一款网格交易EA，在当前市场价格周围按固定间隔放置挂单，利用价格在区间内震荡获利。该EA系统性地在预设的网格水平开设买入和卖出限价/止损单，同时管理多个仓位。它是完整版VR Smart Grid的精简版，配置选项有所减少。
strategy_analysis: VR Smart Grid Lite采用经典网格交易策略，在价格上下方按固定间距布置买卖挂单网格。入场条件为：当价格触及预设网格水平时，对应的限价单或止损单自动触发成交，买入单设在价格下方，卖出单设在价格上方。出场条件主要依赖止盈设定，每个网格层级有独立的止盈目标，当价格回归到目标水平时平仓获利。仓位管理采用固定手数或可配置手数方式，每个网格层级使用相同或递增的交易量。资金管理方面，该EA允许用户设置最大网格层数以控制总敞口，但精简版可能缺少高级资金管理功能。网格策略在震荡行情中表现良好，但在单边趋势行情中面临连续亏损和仓位累积的严重风险。
strategy_analysis_en: VR Smart Grid Lite employs a classic grid trading strategy, placing buy and sell pending orders at fixed intervals above and below the current market price. Entry conditions are triggered when price reaches a predefined grid level, where corresponding limit or stop orders are automatically filled — buy orders below price and sell orders above. Exit conditions primarily rely on take-profit settings, where each grid level has its own profit target that closes the position when price reverts to the target level. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or configurable lot sizes, with each grid level potentially using the same or incrementally increasing trade volume. Money management allows users to set the maximum number of grid levels to control total exposure, though the lite version may lack advanced money management features. While the grid strategy performs well in ranging markets, it faces serious risks of consecutive losses and position accumulation during strong trending conditions.

parameters.name: GridStep
parameters.description: 网格间距（点数），相邻挂单之间的价格距离
parameters.description_en: Grid spacing in points, price distance between adjacent pending orders

parameters.name: MaxGridLevels
parameters.description: 最大网格层数，控制单方向的挂单数量上限
parameters.description_en: Maximum grid levels, upper limit of pending orders per direction

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description: 每单交易手数，每层网格的下单量
parameters.description_en: Trade lot size per order, order volume per grid level

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，每笔交易的盈利目标
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, profit target per trade

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying this EA's orders

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 移动止损点数，0表示不启用追踪止损
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: StartDistance
parameters.description: 首层网格距当前价格的距离（点数）
parameters.description_en: Distance from current price to first grid level in points

pros: 网格策略在震荡行情中可稳定获利，利用价格回归特性反复赚取区间利润
系统化交易无需主观判断，完全按照预设规则自动执行，消除情绪干扰
精简版降低了使用门槛，参数简洁适合初学者快速上手体验网格交易逻辑
pros_en: Grid strategy can profit steadily in ranging markets by repeatedly capturing oscillation profits from price mean reversion
Systematic trading eliminates subjective judgment, executing automatically based on preset rules without emotional interference
The lite version lowers the entry barrier with simplified parameters, making it easy for beginners to experience grid trading logic
cons: 无止损或止损设为0时，单边趋势行情可能导致连续加仓并造成巨大亏损，存在爆仓风险
网格策略资金占用大，多层挂单同时占用保证金，在小资金账户中极易触发保证金不足
精简版功能受限，缺少高级风控机制如动态网格调整、亏损保护和资金曲线管理等关键功能
cons_en: Without stop loss or with SL set to 0, a strong trending market can cause consecutive position additions leading to massive losses and account blow-up risk
Grid strategy requires significant margin, with multiple pending orders simultaneously locking capital, easily triggering insufficient margin on small accounts
The lite version has limited functionality, lacking critical advanced risk controls such as dynamic grid adjustment, loss protection, and equity curve management
improvements: 增加动态网格间距功能，根据ATR或波动率自动调整网格密度以适应不同市场状态
实现整体账户级风控，包括最大回撤限制、浮动亏损阈值自动平仓和紧急全部平仓功能
improvements_en: Add dynamic grid spacing functionality that automatically adjusts grid density based on ATR or volatility to adapt to different market conditions
Implement account-level risk controls including maximum drawdown limits, floating loss threshold auto-close, and emergency close-all functionality

risk_points: 默认止损为0，单边趋势下仓位会无限累积直至爆仓，这是最致命的风险
网格层数过多时保证金占用巨大，可能在极端行情中无法继续开仓导致锁仓亏损
缺乏全局风控机制，没有最大回撤保护或账户权益底线保护
risk_points_en: Default stop loss of 0 means positions accumulate indefinitely during strong trends until account blow-up, the most critical risk
Excessive grid levels consume huge margin, potentially preventing new orders during extreme moves and resulting in locked losses
Lacks global risk controls with no maximum drawdown protection or account equity floor safeguard
